description: A record describing a book, using the 15 elements of the Dublin Core Metadata Element Set, Version 1.1.

main.description: Bibliographic description of a book. Field names match Dublin Core element names; repeatable elements are arrays.

title.description: dc:title. A name given to the resource.

creator.description: dc:creator. Entities primarily responsible for making the resource, e.g. authors. Suggested form: 'Family, Given'.

subject.description: dc:subject. Topics of the resource: keywords, key phrases, or classification codes (e.g. LCSH, DDC).

description.description: dc:description. An account of the resource: abstract, table of contents, or free-text summary.

publisher.description: dc:publisher. Entities responsible for making the resource available.

contributor.description: dc:contributor. Entities responsible for making contributions to the resource, e.g. editors, translators, illustrators.

date.description: dc:date. A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource, usually publication. Recommended format: W3CDTF (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

type.description: dc:type. The nature or genre of the resource. Recommended: a term from the DCMI Type Vocabulary; books are normally 'Text'.

format.description: dc:format. File format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource. Recommended: MIME types for digital editions (e.g. 'application/epub+zip'), free text for physical ones (e.g. 'hardcover', '784 p.').

identifier.description: dc:identifier. Unambiguous references to the resource. Recommended: URIs such as 'urn:isbn:9781492056355', 'https://doi.org/...', or 'https://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q...'.

source.description: dc:source. Related resources from which the described resource is derived, e.g. the original work of a translation. URIs recommended.

language.description: dc:language. Languages of the resource, as BCP 47 language tags (e.g. 'en', 'pt-BR').

relation.description: dc:relation. Related resources, e.g. other editions, volumes of a series, or other org.kirbi.catalog.book records (as at:// URIs). URIs recommended.

coverage.description: dc:coverage. Spatial or temporal topics of the resource, e.g. place names or historical periods.

rights.description: dc:rights. Information about rights held in and over the resource: a statement, or a license URI.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was created. Not a Dublin Core element; this is the AT Protocol convention.
